degree_requirement.value: first professionally qualifying university degree recognized in Germany or a degree from a state or state-recognized vocational academy in computer science
degree_requirement.quote: The prerequisite for admission to the course is a first professionally qualifying university degree recognized in Germany or a degree from a state or state-recognized vocational academy in computer science.

english.quote: Proof is deemed to have been provided if the “Test of English as a Foreign Language” TOEFL iBt (120-95) (New: 5.0 points) or the IELTS test was passed with at least level 7.0.

german.quote: No proof of German language skills is required for English-language Master's degree programs.

aps_required.quote: Applicants with Chinese, Vietnamese or Indian educational certificates must submit a certificate from the Academic Evaluation Center (APS) with their application.

application_route.quote: International degree seeking students generally have to apply for a degree course via uni-assist . However, there are exceptions depending on the respective requirements and the desired degree program!

deadlines.quote: Application period: EU applicants: 1st April – 15th July , 1st October – 15th January Non-EU applicants: 1st April – 31st May , 1st October – 30th November

selection_process.quote: Proof of special aptitude is provided through aptitude assessment procedures in accordance with the Master Computer Science aptitude assessment regulations.

value: Application for the suitability assessment on the website of the faculty
Copy of the original and officially certified translation (German or English) of the degree certificate of the required first university degree including official transcript of records

Confirmation from the first university that at least 80% of the work required for the current university degree program has been completed, as well as information on the current average grade for degree program with entry restrictions
Additional certificates and other suitable documents to determine whether the subject-specific and language requirements are met
Curriculum vitae with previous academic achievements
Module descriptions (or comparable tables of contents) of the modules relevant for the Master's degree program in Computer Science
a letter of motivation outlining both your reasons for wanting to study the degree program and your particular qualifications for it
Proof of the required English language skills at level C 1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) based on the result of an internationally offered test

semester_fee_eur.quote: The semester contribution costs approx. 360 € for direct study students.
